subject: Genetics
title: What Epigenetics Means
description: Learn What Epigenetics Means in one minute.

hook.text: The prefix 'epi' means above. Epigenetics literally means 'above genetics'—changes on top of DNA, not inside it.

buildup.text: Conrad Waddington coined the term in 1942. He imagined a landscape where cells roll downhill into different fates.

discovery.text: Epigenetic changes are chemical tags on DNA or its packaging proteins.

twist.text: Unlike mutations, epigenetic changes are reversible. A silenced gene can be reactivated.

climax.text: Epigenetics explains how one genome produces 200+ cell types, how environment shapes biology, and why identical twins.

punchline.text: The DNA stays the same. The reading changes everything.
